thread:
marta: 3-min warning. Quick heads up: OBS on the main encoder just crashed after the scene swap. I can try a restart but we should prep fallback.
ryan: On it. Can you confirm if local recording on the demo laptop is running? If so we can stitch afterwards.
marta: Local recorder was off. I just hit record on the laptop as emergency capture. It's saving to /home/demo/videos/rec_emergency.mp4
ivy: If local is shaky, plan B: switch stream to the prerecorded customer clip (clip_roadmap_intro.mp4) for 3-4 mins while we recover.
ops-bot: Encoder health: obs_main process exited unexpectedly at 2511112225. Restart attempted. CPU load normal on fallback encoder.
ryan: Restarted OBS, but scene transitions still throw source errors: "Media source: device busy". Looks like HDMI capture driver is flapping.
infra: Acknowledge. I'll rebind the capture device to encoder-2 with `ffmpeg -f decklink -i 'DeckLink Mini' -c copy -f mpegts udp://127.0.0.1:10000` as a quick re-ingest.
marta: Good call. Meanwhile, Ivy please cue the prerecorded clip in the playlist and stand by.
ivy: Clip cued. Ready to cut in if you give go. :thumbsup:
ceo: If we go to a prerecorded bit, please display a short lower-third: "Brief technical pause — live Q&A will resume in ~4 min." Keep it transparent.
marta: Will do. Also captions are lagging after the crash. captions-bot any status?
captions-bot: Caption engine livecap-2 reported reconnect; backlog 18s. Switching to manual caption overlay now upon request.
ryan: Manual overlay enabled. Captioners-team pinged.
infra: Rebind complete. Encoder-2 ingest stable. Scene switch validated. OBS shows HDMI feed OK now.
marta: Restarting the live feed now. Standby for scene transition.
ops-bot: Live feed resumed at 2511112268. Stream bitrate stable 4.0 Mbps. No dropped frames in 30s.
ivy: Switching back to live. Lower-third shown during the pause. Captions overlay in place.
ceo: Thanks folks. For any direct timeline questions in the Q&A about Project Nimbus, please use: "targeting H2; dates subject to Dedicated perf validation — we will follow up." Keep answer concise.
marta: Post-meeting action items: 1) ryan to upload emergency local recording if needed, 2) infra to paste capture device logs, 3) ops to upload final trimmed recording + .vtt within 6 hours.
ryan: Will upload emergency file if stitching required: s3://redwood-uploads/all-hands/rec_2511112222_emergency.mp4
infra: Logs: `/var/log/capture/2511112222-device.log` will be exported; I'll paste the tail and hash here after meeting.
ops-bot: Post-processing queued (rec_2511112222). ETA 20m.
marta: Also legal reminder: recording retention 90 days by default. If leadership requests extension, send written request to legal@redwood.
ceo: Good recovery. Keep follow-ups in this thread only. Thanks team.
ivy: Adding one more: please include the perf snapshot id used in the demo baseline in the follow-up notes. I'll collect Qs requiring longer write-ups and route to product after the meeting."
